messages.en: He's just taking a while to reply. Don't use something so small as an excuse to start a fight.
Fair point. I've calmed down a bit. I'll talk things through with him later.

senses.en_definition: To watch over or guard someone or something to keep them safe or maintain order.
To look after someone and attend to their needs; to care for or bring up a child.
To give careful attention to something in order to maintain, protect, or meet its needs.

collocations.en: be considerate of other people's feelings

messages.en: Farah, are you off today? I haven't seen you at the office.
Yeah, I took the day off to look after Mum at home. She's had a fever since yesterday.
Oh, that explains it. You look after your mum. I can take care of that file.
I've got to work at the counter tomorrow, so I can't join you guys.
No worries, we can just meet up after you finish work.
Have you answered the last question yet?
Not yet, I'm still working on this one. Just give me a moment, okay?
